scope: One character source-art ticket; source-size review only

references.role: Primary current runtime identity, body proportions, costume, colors and facings
Supporting identity, costume, facial and rear/profile detail

image.alpha_note: Generated partial alpha retained unmodified, including near-opaque interior pixels and low-alpha fringe. Lead-owned deterministic cleanup required.

review.identity: Small masculine-presenting blue-skinned demon, short black hair, red horns, pointed ears, yellow eyes, closed dark gold-trimmed coat, dark full trousers and boots preserved; not the obsolete werewolf identity.
observations: All 32 complete full-body sprites observed, with transparent clearance and no cropped horn, boot or hand.
Expected eight-heading sequence observed in every row, with genuine back views and no gross facing reversal.
Rising row has tucked boots and raised balancing arms; descending row unfolds the legs with lower forward/outward hands.
Landing has noticeably deeper bent knees and lower pelvis than anticipation.
Hands empty; no weapons, spells, effects, floor, shadows, text or extra characters observed.
Broadly common skull and body scale at source size; no deliberate per-cell scaling or synthetic mirroring performed.
limitations: Exact one-third head proportion and continuity against the current runtime model must be checked at shared native scale by the lead.
Some paired legs and rear hands are naturally occluded; dark cloth and boots may merge after downsampling.
Profile headings can read slightly rearward; no gross facing defect observed.
Four authored keys only, not complete animation cycles, independent cast keys or timing acceptance.
Generated alpha has not been cleaned or thresholded. Registration and downsampling are not performed by this ticket.
